thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager - elevated queue and 5xx spill observed from gpu-pool-eu-west at ~10:03 UTC. Paging oncall.

alice: I got the page, will coordinate. pinging runtime/infra/sre. any live customer complaints?

bob: seeing spike in 5xxs and warmup timeouts. queue_depth jumped pretty fast.

carol: checking k8s events - several new pods in eu-west landing with ImagePullBackOff. HPA desired >> current.

dave: registry mirror health shows missing manifest for redwood/gpu-runtime:2026 on eu-west mirror. eu-central ok.

alice: mitigation options: route affected traffic to eu-central, manual cluster scale, or rollback image. Which is fastest?

erika: routing is fastest. I can add weighted routing for non-VIP traffic now.

bob: fallback image rollback might be safer for warmup. I can set image to 2025 and restart warmup controllers.

carol: quick metrics snippet:
```
queue_depth_eu_west: 312 -> 978 (6m)
warmup_95p: 14s -> 48s
hpa_replicas_desired: 26 current: 17
```

incident-bot: attached /var/log/runtime/eu-west/queue_2281000123.log

erika: applied routing change - 50% of non-VIP traffic -> eu-central. monitoring now.

alice: bob, please do the image revert to 2025 and restart warmup. dave, can you start mirror resync?

bob: running commands now:
```
kubectl set image deployment/gpu-runtime gpu-runtime=redwood/gpu-runtime:2025 -n runtime
kubectl rollout restart deployment/gpu-warmup -n runtime\```
rollout started ~10:10 UTC.

dave: kicked manual mirror resync for eu-west. found an error in publish job around 10:02 UTC - checksum mismatch when pushing manifest.

alice: support, send initial customer advisory for EU customers (degraded availability).

support-bot: Created ticket INC-9002. Notifications sent to affected customers. ETA to normal ~30-45m.

carol: warmup pods with 2025 are coming up; warmup 95p back down to ~18s at ~10:25 UTC.

bob: queue depth trending down 978 -> 430 over 12m after routing + rollback.

dave: corroborating evidence: build pipeline logs show push to mirror started before artifact finalization; eu-west mirror accepted a partial manifest due to checksum mismatch. replication clients didn't reject, so eu-west served bad manifest.

alice: hypothesis list: H1=bad-publish -> partial/corrupt mirror, H2=runtime v2026 warmup regression, H3=HPA too-aggressive scaling. Prioritize H1 & H2.

dave: opening JIRA RED-INC-228100 to track infra fixes: preflight mirror checksum, block deploy on incomplete replication. assigning to infra leads.

bob: runtime follow-ups - add a guard to prefer previous stable image if warmup fails repeatedly and add gating in deploy pipeline.

carol: short-term mitigation - bumped cluster-autoscaler max nodes +6 in eu-west to give extra headroom while mirror heals.

alice: RCA owner assignment: dave (infra/regsync), bob (runtime), carol (sre). Collect: build logs, registry logs, kube events, HPA metrics, warmup traces, routing changes.

erika: taking handoff. I'll monitor metrics and customer tickets overnight; will escalate on any regression.

alice: incident severity downgraded to SEV-2 at 10:40 UTC. Keep this thread for RCA coordination.

incident-bot: thread preserved and archived for RCA work. Attachments: https://internal/storage/logbundle/2281000123.tar.gz

dave: follow-up action items: add mirror verification job to CI, fail deployment if replication incomplete, add alert on partial mirroring.

bob: follow-ups: automated rollback to prior stable image on warmup failure threshold, deployment gating on mirror health.

carol: follow-ups: tune HPA cool-down to avoid noisy overscale during warmup spikes; add warmup fallback logic.

alice: thanks team. closing active oncall in 20m. handover to erika confirmed. :thumbsup:
